qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Commanding pricing power rooted in high customer switching barriers: airlines face catastrophic operational risk replacing Altéa PSS (reservations, inventory, departure control), while global travel agencies are locked into the two-sided GDS distribution duopoly. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 20.6% and operating ROIC exceeds 200%.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier airline IT and global travel distribution toll booth with insurmountable switching costs, fortress balance sheet (1.1x net debt/NI, 22x interest coverage), and 21% GAAP ROIC. [5-10Y g: air passenger boarded volume 4.5% + GDS booking recovery 2.0% + hospitality IT expansion 1.5% - IT capex drag 0.5% + net buyback 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 20.6% and operating ROIC >200%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion exceeds 100% (114% in FY25). Altéa PSS and Navitaire power mission-critical passenger service systems for top-tier airlines under long-term 10-15 year contracts with near-zero voluntary churn. GDS travel distribution holds >40% global share in a resilient duopoly with Sabre. Balance sheet has €976M cash against €2.45B debt with €1.80B EBIT covering interest 22x.
